description: This Dart source file defines the OrderProvider class for managing orders in a restaurant mobile application. It includes data models, methods for placing orders, simulating order progress, loading order history, and handling real-time status updates. The file interacts with local database storage and uses streams to simulate real-time order status updates.

classes.name: OrderSummary
classes.description: Data model representing a summary of an order, including id, creation time, status, fulfillment type, list of items, and total amount in LKR.

methods.name: placeOrder
methods.description: Creates a new order in the database, generates a unique ID, initiates a simulated order progress stream, and returns the order summary.

methods.name: statusStream
methods.description: Provides a stream of status updates ('preparing', 'on_the_way', 'delivered') for a specific order.

methods.name: _simulateProgress
methods.description: Private method to simulate order status changes over time and update the database and status stream.

methods.name: loadHistory
methods.description: Loads and returns a list of past orders from the local database, ordered by creation date descending.
